why: Form 4 of the types inventory: the polymorphic `this` type of a class is read as its constraint, the class's instance type. Query.where and Query.take are fluent methods whose result type is `this`; where binds its argument to a local first (proved), take is unchanged (proved). text reads the chain back, unchanged (proved). longer takes `other: this` and commutes its comparison (proved); sameLimit takes `other: this` and compares the limit with the other's part count instead of its limit (witnessed). Named extends Query and calls the chain it inherits on this: both swaps the order of the two parts (witnessed), capped binds the first link of the chain to a local first (proved). built calls the chain on a Named value from a free function, binding the first link to a local first (proved).
